stories.title: TEST - Log in with UNIMAS email
stories.want: to log in with my UNIMAS email
stories.ac:
Given a registered siswa.unimas.my account, when I enter valid credentials and tap Log in, then I see my Home screen within 2 seconds
Given a wrong password, when I tap Log in, then an error shows in under 1 second
stories.tasks:
Login screen matches the Figma design
Firebase Auth is wired up
5 widget tests pass in CI by Thursday
PR reviewed by 1 teammate before merge
